Modern Flat-Panel Kitchen Cabinets

A European flat-panel door, also called a slab door, is one smooth surface with no frame. It is the look of modern European kitchens and pairs naturally with handleless designs, using integrated finger pulls or push-to-open hardware.

  • One flat surface with no frame, so doors wipe clean in one pass
  • Clean, minimal lines for modern homes and condos
  • Can go fully handleless with finger pulls or push-to-open

Finishes

  • Matte. A soft, low-shine surface that feels calm and modern; fingerprints show less.
  • High gloss. A mirror-like shine that makes a room feel bigger, but shows fingerprints the most.
  • Wood grain. A warm wood look with real texture, and the most forgiving of everyday wear.

Best for: New modern builds, condos, and anyone who wants a calm, minimal kitchen that is easy to keep clean.
